name: Maximalism
description: Clashing color, thick frames, and pattern stacked on pattern.
bestFor: Posters and campaigns that should feel loud on purpose.
promptFragment: Visual style: Maximalism. Fill the page with colliding saturated colors, stripes or repeats, a heavy display face, thick borders, and hard offset shadows. Mix scales and let decoration crowd the edge. Avoid empty space, hairline rules, and a single quiet color. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
